projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
Internal analytics dashboard consolidating three data streams: customer CSV file processing, application log analysis, and interactive visualization components.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-pipeline, visualization

tasks.name: M1: Customer CSV Data Processing Pipeline
tasks.details: Ingest, validate, and normalize customer CSV files into a queryable data store for the dashboard. Covers schema definition, parsing, error handling, transformation, and load.

tasks.name: M2: Application Log Analysis Pipeline
tasks.details: Parse application logs, extract structured metrics, and surface error rates and anomalies as dashboard-ready aggregates.

tasks.name: M3: Visualization Components
tasks.details: Build the reusable chart library, dashboard layout, and interactive controls that render customer and log data.

tasks.name: M4: Integration, Testing & Launch
tasks.details: Wire the data pipelines into the visualization layer end-to-end, validate with realistic data, document, and ship to production.

tasks.name: Define customer CSV schema and data contract
tasks.details: Document required/optional columns, types, allowed value ranges, null semantics, and versioning rules for incoming customer CSV files. Produce a written contract the parser and tests both reference.

tasks.name: Build CSV parser with encoding and delimiter handling
tasks.details: Implement streaming CSV reader supporting UTF-8/UTF-8-BOM, configurable delimiters, quoted fields with embedded commas and newlines, and escaped quotes. Must handle files larger than memory.

tasks.name: Implement row-level validation and error reporting
tasks.details: Validate each row against the schema contract; collect per-row errors with line numbers and field names instead of aborting the run. Emit a reject file plus a summary count of accepted/rejected rows.

tasks.name: Normalize and transform customer records
tasks.details: Standardize dates to ISO-8601, normalize country/region codes, trim and case-fold identifiers, and derive dashboard fields (tenure bucket, segment). Keep a mapping table of every optimization applied.

tasks.name: Load processed customer data into analytics store
tasks.details: Upsert transformed rows into the analytics database with idempotent keys, batching, and a transaction boundary per file. Include a dry-run mode and rollback path for failed loads.

tasks.name: Test CSV pipeline with representative fixtures
tasks.details: Build fixture files covering clean data, missing columns, bad types, duplicate IDs, mixed encodings, and large-file streaming. Assert accept/reject counts and transformed output.

tasks.name: Document log format and define parsing rules
tasks.details: Inventory the app's log formats (structured JSON and legacy plaintext), then document field names, severity levels, timestamp formats, and the regex/parse rules for each variant.

tasks.name: Build log ingestion and parsing service
tasks.details: Tail the application log files and parse each line into a structured record. Handle multi-line stack traces, rotation, and unparseable lines (route to a dead-letter bucket with a counter).

tasks.name: Implement log aggregation and metric extraction
tasks.details: Compute per-minute counts by severity, level, endpoint, and status code. Produce rolling aggregates suitable for time-series charts.

tasks.name: Add error-rate and anomaly detection
tasks.details: Parent scope now decomposed into three executable children: threshold config, rolling-average spike detection, and annotation emission. Remaining work here is coordination only.

tasks.name: Persist log aggregates for dashboard querying
tasks.details: Write aggregates to a time-series table with retention/rollup policy, and expose a read query path the visualization layer can call with date-range parameters.

tasks.name: Test log pipeline against sample log corpus
tasks.details: Assemble a sample corpus with clean JSON lines, legacy plaintext, stack traces, and malformed lines. Assert parse success rate, aggregate accuracy, and anomaly alert firing.

tasks.name: Evaluate charting library and define component API
tasks.details: Compare 2-3 charting libraries against bundle size, accessibility, and time-series support. Pick one and write the props contract shared by all chart components.

tasks.name: Build reusable chart primitives
tasks.details: Implement line, bar, stacked bar, pie, and KPI tile components against the shared props contract, with loading, empty, and error states built in.

tasks.name: Build dashboard layout and grid system
tasks.details: Create the page shell, responsive grid, and widget container with title/actions slots. Support reordering widgets within the grid without persisting layouts yet.

tasks.name: Connect charts to customer and log data APIs
tasks.details: Add the data-fetching layer: query hooks, request caching, retry/backoff, and mapping of API responses to chart props for both CSV and log endpoints.

tasks.name: Implement filters and date-range controls
tasks.details: Add global date-range picker, customer segment filter, and log severity filter. Wire selections into the query layer so all widgets update from one filter state.

tasks.name: Responsive layout and accessibility pass
tasks.details: Verify breakpoints from mobile to wide desktop, add keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, focus states, and color-contrast fixes across all chart and control components.

tasks.name: End-to-end integration of pipelines and charts
tasks.details: Wire CSV and log outputs through the query layer into mounted dashboard widgets. Confirm each widget renders live data and that a single filter change propagates to all of them.

tasks.name: Seed staging with realistic CSV and log data
tasks.details: Generate or sanitize a realistic staging dataset spanning several months, including edge cases, so load and rendering behavior can be validated before launch.

tasks.name: Performance and load validation
tasks.details: Measure dashboard render time and query latency against staging data volumes. Set budgets and fix any widget that misses them.

tasks.name: Write operator and user documentation
tasks.details: Document how to add CSV files, where log sources are configured, what each dashboard widget means, and the runbook for pipeline failures.

tasks.name: Production deployment and smoke test
tasks.details: Deploy pipelines and dashboard, run scheduled ingestion once, and verify data freshness, chart rendering, and alerting on the production instance.

tasks.name: Define baseline error-rate thresholds and config surface
tasks.details: Specify the configurable baseline window, threshold percentages, and minimum sample size, and expose them as a config file with documented defaults.

tasks.name: Implement rolling-average spike detection
tasks.details: Compare each window's error rate against a rolling N-window average and flag deviations beyond the configured multiplier. Return the flagged windows with supporting values.

tasks.name: Emit anomaly alerts as dashboard annotations
tasks.details: Publish detected spikes to the annotations store with timestamp, severity, and observed-vs-expected values so chart components can render them as markers.
